label: Creature: ordered to a universal cause of being versus caused in being by some other being
resolution: CREATURE_1 (DEF-CREATURE, IsCreatureOfUniversalCause) is the q.13 a.5 sense: ordered to God as principle and cause, with God read as a cause of the being of every other being that causes x's being. CREATURE_2 (IsCausedInBeingByAnother) is the broad gloss: some other being, a secondary cause included, causes x's being. CREATURE_1 entails CREATURE_2 by definition. The converse is not definitional: the controls of specs/creature-senses.toml give a model in which a being is CREATURE_2 and not CREATURE_1. Every statement that speaks of creatures takes CREATURE_1: 'Everything other than the primary is CREATURE_1', 'Every creature having the selected perfection has it caused by the primary', 'The esse of every CREATURE_1 is received in some principle' (the q.7 a.2 reading, said of things made by God) and the formal facts of the Fourth-Way attribution readings. One statement passes between the senses: 'Whatever is CREATURE_2 is CREATURE_1' (b7d4eede-ab50-5522-8902-f33238fa234d; its antecedent is CREATURE_2 and its consequent CREATURE_1). Earlier its paraphrase glossed its consequent broadly, so that chaining it with the q.7 a.2 reading equivocated (the rejected first draft of #1494). It is now read with CREATURE_1 as consequent, so it is the substantive sense bridge, and it is derived (causedInBeingByAnotherIsCreature1) from the proved Fourth-Way consequence STMT-MAXIMAL-CAUSE-WITHOUT-DISTINCT-ESSE-CAUSE and the weak premise 'Whatever has its being caused is in act as to being'. Arguments that pass from CREATURE_2 to CREATURE_1 list it in sense_bridges: OTHERS-ARE-CREATURES-FROM-PARTICIPATION, its own derivation (role conclusion) and the derivation of 'Whatever has its being caused by another has its esse received in some principle'. SCOPE CONDITION (definition 80dea550) binds both senses: the divine processions are no instances of CausesIn c x esse with c distinct from x. KNOWN GAP (type-level enforcement): the statements b7d4eede, 29e71e43 and 612078bf have Lean declarations that take Creature as a parameter (CausedInBeingByAnotherIsCreature, CreatureEsseIsReceived, OthersAreCreaturesReading), and bind-check matches a hypothesis to a statement by head constant. A later result that instantiated, say, 29e71e43 at CREATURE_2 (IsCausedInBeingByAnother) would therefore bind without error, although the statement's record takes CREATURE_1. For these three statements equivocation is excluded by the records and review, not by the kernel; only the results of specs/creature-senses.toml instantiate them, at the CREATURE_1 constant. Sense-specific wrapper declarations (CREATURE_1 fixed in the statement's own Lean declaration) would close the gap; they would be new statements, related to these by a checked equivalence, and are not added here.
